items.label: Screenshot
items.text: Capture the whole screen or one window via the bridge (MCP: amiga_screenshot).

items.label: Palette
items.text: The screen's colour registers as swatches (MCP: amiga_get_palette / amiga_set_palette).

items.label: Copper list
items.text: The active copper list (GfxBase ActiView → LOFCprList) decoded instruction by instruction (MCP: amiga_copper_list).

items.label: Sprite inspector
items.text: Hardware sprite state, including the Intuition mouse pointer (MCP: amiga_sprites).

items.label: Bitmap viewer
items.text: Render raw planar memory at an address as an image.

items.label: IFF viewer
items.text: Decode an ILBM file on the Amiga and show it.

items.label: Visual diff
items.text: Capture A and B and highlight changed pixels.
